agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Breaks high-level goals into concrete, ordered tasks.
agents.cronTask: Review the backlog and propose the next action.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.role: Gathers context and references for the current task.
agents.cronTask: Refresh source material for open questions.

agents.name: Executor
agents.role: Carries out approved tasks and reports results.
